name: 案内役のスタイル選択
prompt:
Correct attempt 1 using the same two references. Keep the image at 390 x 348 and white.

Place the heading 「案内のしかたを選ぶ」 at x=72, y=24, Meiryo Regular 14/24. Place 「おすすめの案内」 at x=38, y=72, Meiryo Regular 12/16.

Use one white option group x=32, y=100, width=326, height=218, with a 16 px radius and subtle neutral border. Inside it, keep the three rows and quiet neutral dividers exactly:
- Row 1 label 「親しみやすく」 at x=82, y=122, 14/24; explanation 「やさしい言葉で、一緒に進めます」 at x=82, y=146, 12/16.
- Divider from x=50 to x=340 at y=169.
- Row 2 label 「短くわかりやすく」 at x=82, y=190, 14/24; explanation 「要点を絞ってお伝えします」 at x=82, y=214, 12/16.
- Divider from x=50 to x=340 at y=239.
- Row 3 label 「じっくり詳しく」 at x=82, y=262, 14/24; explanation 「理由や背景まで説明します」 at x=82, y=286, 12/16.

Use Meiryo Regular 14/24 for option labels and Regular 12/16 for explanations. Keep title, section and row hierarchy distinct; don't bold every line. Correct attempt 1's heading position and wide/lower option group. Keep text inset at x=82. Align each source-inspired icon in a slim column at x=45, centered to its row: glasses for the friendly option, leaf for the concise option, and an analysis/pie-chart icon for the detailed option. Icons are monochrome slate (#526173), consistent and quiet. Do not use the source's assorted icon colors.

The canvas and option group are pure white, with fine neutral outlines and neutral dividers. Do not use the broad mint surfaces in the mock/native, any green tint, purple accent, or strong shadow. No extra cards, close icon, app chrome, selection state, checkmark, or added copy. Preserve the exact three Japanese options and descriptions. Entire 390x348 component visible. Static only; no navigation or behavior.
reviewNotes: Attempt 2 preserves all three options and source icon motifs in quiet slate on a white surface. At 390x348, the option group remains about 20 px wider and 4 px lower than the target; heading/section are slightly left and lower. Keep needs-correction; source and native are untouched.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
